1445-4871-5631-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5631-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

824-2728-5231-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5231-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5231-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

225-1308-2557-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-1308-2557-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-4365-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
851-4094-4365-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

880-2757-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4067-7064-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4067-7064-7824.description:
Activate Professor Zei's first ability by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards due to Bard.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Professor Zei.
Repeat.

628-2511-7197.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1069-3835-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-3835-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

4924-6867-7043.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1863-2638-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-2638-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1863-2638-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

4017-5070-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5070-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1530-4417-6585.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 5 or less.
1530-4417-6585.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Yuna triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from Second Chance.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2713-5140-5640.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Kenrith's ability, targeting any creature you control.
Resolve both Kenrith abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and any creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-5640.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

185-771-1031-3098-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
185-771-1031-3098-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Call to Mind without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Call to Mind, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Call to Minds, causing you to return Mystic Retrieval and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Mystic Retrieval without paying its mana cost, targeting Call to Mind.
Invocation of the Founders triggers, copying Mystic Retrieval, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, causing you to return Call to Mind and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

618-1938-2292.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1479-2719-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

654-1315-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
654-1315-5720-5721.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1684-2178-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-2438-4871.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Rakka Mar trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1017-1656-4041-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1656-4041-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Merfolk Looter's ability by tapping it, causing you to loot.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

7-215-4050-4749.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with +1/+1 counters on them.
7-215-4050-4749.description:
Cast Somberwald Beastmaster by paying {G}.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, 3/3 Beast and 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Wolf and two Beasts, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Somberwald Beastmaster from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

602-1561.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
602-1561.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw cards equal to half your library size and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Feast of Sanity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.

1558-1977-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Tivit does not have summoning sickness.
Tivit cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-1977-4231.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Tivit.
Tivit triggers, creating at least three Food, three Clue, and three Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1737-2557-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Prototype Portal and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

101-500-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
101-500-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Vampire Charmseeker and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Both Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter the battlefield, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

11-1484-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Primal Wellspring can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
11-1484-4276.description:
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Primal Wellspring by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Turnabout.
Primal Wellspring triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Turnabout, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Turnabout and returning the original Turnabout to your hand.
Resolve Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Primal Wellspring and all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Primal Wellspring triggers, creating a copy of Turnabout.
 Resolve Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Primal Wellspring and all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

2187-2665-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Possessed Skaab.
2187-2665-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the token Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
